children: Sprinklr reported second quarter fiscal 2027 total revenue of $213.7 million and subscription revenue of $194.8 million, representing year‑over‑year increases of 1% and 3%, respectively. GAAP net income for the quarter was $7.1 million (diluted $0.03) while non‑GAAP diluted EPS was $0.11. The company generated net cash from operations of $18.2 million and free cash flow of $13.1 million for the quarter.
Total revenue: $213.7 million for Q2 FY2027, up 1% year‑over‑year (Q2 FY2026: $212.0 million).
Subscription revenue: $194.8 million for Q2 FY2027, up 3% year‑over‑year (Q2 FY2026: $188.5 million).
Gross profit (U.S. GAAP): $139.2 million for the quarter; gross margin reported at 65% (non‑GAAP gross margin 66%).
Operating income (GAAP): $10.0 million for the quarter; non‑GAAP operating income: $31.3 million (non‑GAAP operating margin 15%).
Net income (GAAP): $7.1 million, diluted EPS $0.03; Non‑GAAP net income: $25.2 million, non‑GAAP diluted EPS $0.11.
Cash and marketable securities: total cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities of $452.9 million as of July 31, 2026.
Cash flow: net cash provided by operating activities $18.2 million for the quarter and free cash flow $13.1 million.
Remaining performance obligations (RPO) totaled $1.03 billion, up 11% year‑over‑year, with current RPO (cRPO) up 3% year‑over‑year, indicating contracted demand and forward revenue visibility.
Company emphasized continued AI innovation and increasing enterprise adoption as drivers of new ARR growth and product momentum.
Management stated progress on a business transformation aimed at positioning Sprinklr for durable growth, citing enterprise traction and contracted demand.
Conference call and webcast scheduled to discuss results and outlook, reflecting ongoing investor engagement and transparency on execution plans.
